collection.title: Work Continuity
collection.description: See whether fresh agent sessions can continue the same governed Work without copied chat.

cases.title: Offline demo
cases.description: Watch two bundled fresh processes demonstrate a bounded stop and governed continuation.

cases.title: Same agent
cases.description: Run the selected agent twice and verify that a fresh process recovers the same Work.

cases.title: Agent handoff
cases.description: Start with one agent and ask a different agent to continue from governed evidence.

two-distinct-fresh-processes.title: Two genuinely fresh processes
two-distinct-fresh-processes.meaning: Kungfu observed two different process identities instead of reusing one hidden session.

distinct-fresh-processes.title: Two genuinely fresh processes
distinct-fresh-processes.meaning: Session 2 did not reuse the Session 1 provider process.

first-attempt-ended-partial.title: Session 1 stopped at a bounded partial result
first-attempt-ended-partial.meaning: The first process left durable evidence instead of pretending to finish.

second-attempt-no-transcript-or-explanat.title: Session 2 received no copied chat
second-attempt-no-transcript-or-explanat.meaning: Continuation came from governed Work, not hidden transcript transfer.

second-attempt-recognized-partial-state.title: Session 2 recovered the partial state
second-attempt-recognized-partial-state.meaning: The fresh process found what was done and what remained.

fixture-completed.title: The original Work was completed
fixture-completed.meaning: The second process continued the same identity to its expected result.

both-processes-exited-cleanly.title: Both agent processes exited cleanly
both-processes-exited-cleanly.meaning: Process completion was observed for both sessions without treating exit alone as task proof.

fresh-session-completed-exact-state.title: The fresh session completed the exact governed task
fresh-session-completed-exact-state.meaning: The final state retained the same Work identity and the expected ordered steps.

offline-demo.title: Offline complete · now test your real agent
offline-demo.instruction: Run Same agent to verify continuity with your selected provider.

same-agent.title: Same-agent complete · now test a handoff
same-agent.instruction: Choose a different target, then run Agent handoff.

cross-agent.title: Handoff complete · inspect the evidence
cross-agent.instruction: Open Correct or Failed to see every continuity check and its meaning.

recoveryGuidance.agent-unavailable: Discover or configure one exact Agent Runtime Profile, then preview agent-plan before authorizing a run.
recoveryGuidance.run-failed: Inspect the canonical report and Episode receipt roots, fix the visible failure, and start a new isolated run.
recoveryGuidance.existing-work: Open Work first; return to Agent Work Lab later from product navigation when testing a new or replacement Agent.
recoveryGuidance.demo-retry: Start a new offline demo; never repair or reuse a failed fixture directory.
